elements.name: Register a new user selecting the "Do Not Use" group

steps.name: I am on the home page
I click on the registration link
I fill in the registration form with valid details
I should see a confirmation message indicating successful registration

embeddings.name: Register a new user selecting the "Do Not Use" group

steps.name: an existing admin logs into the application
the admin navigates to user management
the admin searches for the newly registered user
the admin updates the newly registered user's role
the admin saves the user changes
the newly registered user should have the "Admin" role
